messages:
sam (eng-ml): quick thought: propose adding a tiny compatibility shim in the onboarding pipeline that verifies model -> runtime kernel mapping before any benching. catches layout/tokenizer mismatches early.

lee (eng-platform): good idea. we need a compact kernel-hint field in the descriptor and a deterministic check that runs in <30s.

nina (eng-sre): also add safety limits: this shim must be non-GPU and low-priority. don't let it touch prod infra.

omar (product): customers want "fast feedback". can we show a "shim pass" state in Console so they know it's progressing?

rachel (qa): shim should emit a tiny artifact with tokenization checksum and kernel_probe_log so QA can reproduce. add repro seeds.

ci-bot: queued: onboard/shim-probe/3401234567 (kernel-check)

sam (eng-ml): ok next: I'll include kernel_hint, probe_seed, and shim_timeout in RFC draft. owners: sam (design), lee (api), rachel (qa), nina (SRE). will post brief RFC today.
